proposed_capability: MoonWake Sixth Gear P141→P95→P82→P08→P07→P124: bounded game-native household queue supervisor to prevent duplicate/mutually-exclusive autonomously queued work, measure duration against source-attested base/activity factors (moodlet, temperament, balance, trait), and propose urgent-need preemption or stalled-action reobservation only with fresh player-safe evidence. No actual EA queue effects without local exact-patch proof.
player_save_control_impact: Never cancel a player/unknown queue entry, overwrite saves, change OS controls or manipulate live game/Windows APIs. One evidence-proven proposal per Sim per verified capture. Player activity, incomplete action origin/semantic proofs, unverified needs, stale clock, disabled policy or cooldown must protect queue; never infer a game-wide hard queue maximum.
expected_outcome: Bounded queued-action duplicate/contradiction audit and conservative queue budget reuse; empirical duration correction from independently observed same-activity completed samples, separate proven moodlet/temperament/balance/trait multipliers and clock/progress; urgent-need and predicted-time-to-critical replan with anti-thrash cooldown and reobserve-after-effect; one optional household policy seam with no dispatch.
negative_tests: Two source-different actions with the same target are not automatically contradictory; mutual-exclusion proof required
Replayed duration sample and unrelated action/build samples rejected
Unknown traits/modifiers do not produce timeout-driven cancellation
Unknown or active player, protected goal and ambiguous queue origin deny cancel
Duplicate queue slot identities invalid, no guessed UI queue cap
Paused or stale clock cannot support activity stall predictions
Six needs must be verified with finite values; trend in simulation-active clock units only
Cooldown blocks oscillation after switch; urgent need served by active action does not preempt
One candidate maximum; no enqueue/cancel/desktop effect authority, no stored background data
rollback_path: Revert isolated policy-only PR. Existing native household policy and queue-capacity evaluator remain unchanged without the optional observation; no user game files or saves mutated.
unresolved_unknowns: Exact installed EA interaction IDs/queue limits and Sims clock observation unavailable in connected GitHub runtime
Moodlet/temperament/balance/trait speed multipliers require patch-specific attested causal evidence, not guessed numbers
True native cancellation/requeue requires local game build/TGI or native script hook and player-protection tests under issue #171
BI-002 hunger game certification remains ACTIVE
